title: There's a River in the Amazon That Reaches 200 Degrees

scenes.text: There's a river in the Amazon that cooks animals that fall in.
It's the Boiling River in Peru, and its hottest stretch reaches about 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
The hot part runs almost four miles.
Small animals that fall in are cooked.
There's no volcano nearby. Hot springs feed it with water rising from deep underground.
A rainforest river hot enough to make tea. Don't fall in.

description:
The Boiling River in the Peruvian Amazon reaches about 200 degrees Fahrenheit along a hot stretch of almost four miles.
It isn't heated by a volcano but by hot springs.
Would you go swimming?
first_comment: Would you dip a toe in? Be honest.
